resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1928 and says the tower has protected the county's northwest corner since then. The storymap gives 1929. No third source was found, so the record keeps the register's year.

sources.title: Fire Towers of Pennsylvania (StoryMap data, Shawn Lesitsky)

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: 1928 (register) vs 1929 (storymap); kept 1928. The storymap is cited through its ArcGIS data file because the MapSeries page is a script shell. No source found for current condition or public access. The 1968 item describes a paint crew, not tower staffing. The 1937 to 1968 items are newspaper reprints on the Eastern U.S. Lookouts page; the original clippings were not checked. The 1968 item (The News-Herald) names the painters with towns and calls the four people Pennsylvania Department of Forests and Waters employees; the story uses that wording.
